ruling: D-242, Paul 2026-10-18: one Windows run is both A1 and A2 (the lighter standard of D-201); what a store records about the build itself is masked from this fixed, reviewed list instead of a measured A1/A2 variance
used_by: tools/compute_parity.py --single-reference (key/value tables of the SQLite stores only, per key and JSON field, and only when both values have the same JSON type or, for an entry with or_null, are that type or null; shape differences, every unlisted key, every non-stamp row and every non-SQLite artifact stay exact; the file must be committed and clean, and the report records its sha256 and HEAD blob)
never_listed: the bundle zip and its .sha256, density.json, the shown-areas table and manifest, the ingest/extend zips and every voter-derived row or column (compare_zip and compare_file never read this list); file hashes recorded in a store (roads_sha256, source_sha256: these stay equal only because the run judges both builds from one set of inputs); an absolute path; an id or a key
rules: store is the file name of a SQLite store a step of tools/build_step.py STEPS writes; table is its key/value table (metadata, or meta for the walk store); key is the exact key; pointer is '' for the whole value or a JSON pointer into the JSON value, `*` standing for exactly one segment (so `/timing/*` leaves out every timing but the set of phases must match); writer is path:line of the statement that writes the value; needle is a substring of that line (tools/test_compute.py checks the line, so an edited writer fails the test and the entry is re-reviewed); kind: clock = wall clock, duration = elapsed time, measured = a reading of the writing process; or_null: the value is this type, or null where the writer's call is unavailable

entries.why: wall clock of the build; the only street.metadata key that differed between A1 and A2 of the full-chain run (COMPUTE.md section 9)
wall clock of the build; the bundle copies it into its manifest text, which is why a run judges bundle from the score store of one build (--inputs-from)

elapsed seconds of the W1 census inside the w1 document (stored as metadata[w1] by scores_writer.py from build_scores_v3.py:557); the status, rows_checked, matches and source_sha256 beside it stay compared
wall clock of the build, a raw ISO text (not JSON)
seconds of each phase and the total inside the qa document; the phase names must match, every other field of qa stays compared
peak working set from a Windows call (build_walk.py:102-120): a number on Windows, null in the container, where the call is unavailable
